title: US firm launches 'tactical-edge' sensors for tracking troops, military supplies | Rune Technologies News
summary: Rune Technologies introduced TyrSense, a ruggedized NFC-based sensor system designed to track military personnel, casualties, and supplies in communications-denied environments by recording location data locally and syncing with the TyrOS platform.
body_markdown:
Electronics260 covered Rune Technologies by Marie Donlon in a piece titled “US firm launches 'tactical-edge' sensors for tracking troops, military supplies.” Rune Technologies introduced TyrSense, a ruggedized NFC-based sensor system designed to track military personnel, casualties, and supplies in communications-denied environments by recording location data locally and syncing with the TyrOS platform.


Read the full article[here](https://electronics360.globalspec.com/article/24069/us-firm-launches-tactical-edge-sensors-for-tracking-troops-military-supplies) .
